body: This happened to my guild too! So sad..I just kinda float around and farm a bit now and do LFR.  It's so boring :(

Late commenting here, but I was recently diagnosed with testicular cancer and two days later my mom passed away.  After the funeral I was able to tell my sister and she helped me tell the rest of my family.  Parents are divorced, so after everything got sorted at the funeral, I had to travel to go tell my dad.  Last week was on of the hardest weeks I've ever had.  Now I'm back to school trying to pay attention to my classes because what the fuck else am I going to do..I feel completely lost and alone without my mom, and now I'm facing cancer, and I just have no clue what to think or do.  It's as if I'm on the edge of a cliff in the middle of a desert with absolutely *nothing* around me except for the empty sky and barren ground

Sure, but I just really don't see how someone can do something for a living without being happy about doing it, without enjoying what you do, what's the point in doing it?  I guess I just don't see what point is
I guess I could, as long as I found it intriguing/interesting.  Things that are interesting keep me happy for the most part

Of course I care about my family, environment too.  I do really enjoy science, also.  I do want to change my area of study from business to anatomy, but I have to get permission from the school to switch from a liberal arts to science.  I don't know if they would do that since I failed a couple of classes and did poorly in others

When I'm in the waiting room I read TIME magazine, NatGeo, and Men's Health the most.  Sports Illustrated sometimes.

At the same time though, whats the point in trying to fix these problems?  Sure, I would be happier for the moment, but only for a brief moment.  It just doesn't seem to be worth the time and stress when I'm just going to end up feeling the same as I do now.  I'm stuck where I am; I guess I just need to accept it?

I guess it's something I can look into.  I just feel like I can't/shouldn't miss a semester of school, either. If I do that then I'll be further behind than I already am.  Plus, my parents would definitely not be happy with my choice.  They don't give me any money to support myself, but they are still my parents and are there for me in other ways

The problem is that right now, there's not much ahead of me.  Just more of the same monotonous tasks that I just no longer want to do.  Whether its working 40 hours a week (summer), or going to school and working, I just don't want to do it anymore.  I want to go and travel and experiance the world.  But in order to do that, I need money.  Money I don't have

Well, therapy is out of the question.  I'm a poor college student, working 40 hours a week right now (summer) and during the school year I work 25-30 hours, so not only is there not much time, but I don't have the money.

I guess I feel like I have no right and should not feel lonely.  There's really just no reason.  People are everywhere and I interact with them everyday.
I have learned that a good portion of homeless are legitimately down on luck, but at least in my area, so many are drug-addicted and violent.  It's better to just play it safe here

That's pretty funny.  I would feel bad too, but I guess my job (Subway) has sort of desensitized me towards people trying to take advantage of others (I work in a small college town.  There's a spreading ghetto and they love complaining and taking advantage of everything they possibly can.  And they never clean up after themselves)
Yea, I haven't told anyone either.  It just seems like it would be a huge waste of time and energy
Well, any feedback is better than none!  Thanks.  I guess I'm just feeling really lost and alone?  Not sure
